run_unrealstereo4k_conversion: run the unrealstereo4k conversion script to process scenes into WAI format using the YAML config
process_unrealstereo4k_scene: process a single UnrealStereo4K scene by converting disparity maps to depth and symlinking images
convert_disparity_to_depth: convert disparity maps from numpy files to depth EXR files using stereo baseline and intrinsics
parse_camera_extrinsics: parse camera intrinsics and extrinsics from text files and compute camera-to-world transformation matrices
store_wai_scene_metadata: store scene metadata including frames, intrinsics, and modalities as JSON using the WAI store_data utility
